title: Describing a Transcription Factor Dependent Regulation of the MicroRNA Transcriptome
protocol: Identify transcription factor binding sites in the promoter of microRNA genes using data mining approach.
Open the table browser in the UCSC genome browser.
Extract chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing data from ENCODE project.
Save output as a .txt file and into a spreadsheet.
Sort and filter for the transcription factor of interest (e.g., STAT2).
Copy list of microRNA promoters based on H3K4me3 epigenetics signature into a .txt file.
Map data to determine median binding affinity using C sharp code from supplemental coding file 1.
Plate 1.5 x 10^6 cells from 293 human embryonic kidney cell line in a 10 cm plate at approximately 50% confluence (DMEM with 10% FBS).

Transfect cells from the 293 human embryonic kidney cell line with 5 µg of GFP lentivirus containing shRNA directed to the transcription factor of interest and 5 µg of packaging vectors using transfection reagent for adherent cells according to the manufacturer's protocol.
As a control, transfect the cells from the 293 human embryonic kidney cell line with scrambled shRNA and packaging vectors according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Keep the transfection mix on cells for 16 hr at 37 °C in a CO2 incubator.
Change media to 10 ml fresh 10% DMEM media with 10% FBS after 48 hr post transfection.
Centrifuge the cell culture at 300 x g for 5 min and collect infectious supernatant.
Filter the supernatant through a 0.45 µm syringe filter (25-mm surfactant free cellulose acetate membrane) to remove any floating cells.
Concentrate the supernatant and collect lentivirus using an ultracentrifugal filter device with a threshold of 100 kDa.
Spin at 950 x g for 30 - 60 min until volume is concentrated to less than 250 µl.
Store the concentrated virus at -80 °C.
Thaw frozen lentivirus from -80 °C freezer to room temperature.
Transfer 100 µl of viral supernatant to a fresh 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Bring up the volume in the tube to 1 ml with reduced serum medium.
Add hexadimethrine bromide to 1 ml virus suspension for final concentration of 10 ng/ml, mix gently and let stand for 5 min.
Centrifuge 5 x 10^6 cells for each transduction.
Gently resuspend the cell pellet in 0.5 ml of media containing virus.
Incubate the cells for 4 - 24 hours.
Add 0.5 ml of medium with 20% FBS to achieve a final concentration of 10% FBS.
Wait 48 to 72 hours before proceeding.
Stain the cells with propidium iodide (PI) and green fluorescent protein (GFP).
Measure the rate of GFP+/PI- cells using a FACS sorter.
Sort positive cell population to GFP expression (GFP+) by FACS sorter.
Determine the levels of a transcription factor of interest before and after infecting cells with designated shRNA using Western immune blotting.
Isolate RNA from transfected cells using a commercial kit.
Label the isolated RNA and hybridize it to microRNA microarray.
Validate the most differentially expressed microRNAs using real-time PCR.
Determine the ratio of microRNA genes harboring the transcription factor binding sites / total microRNA from the list generated in 1.3.
Count the number of downregulated genes in transcription factor-shRNA transfected cells that have the transcription factor binding sites from the list generated in 1.3.
Calculate the observed ratio by dividing the counted number of downregulated genes with binding sites by the total number of downregulated genes.
Use χ2 statistics to compare the observed and expected ratios.
Determine whether the list of downregulated genes is enriched with transcription factor binding sites based on the comparison.
